item.tib: dbal phur yang snying rgyud las sa bslang khro bcu'i rgyan bkod kyi le'u
item.coloph: ces pa'i gong chog sa bslang rgyan bkod le'u/ ston pa gshen rab kyi sras/ dbal bon stag la me 'bar gyis 'khros pa khrag gdong dmar po la brgyud cing khrag gdong gis dran pa la bshad/ dran pa nam mkhas pom ra'i thugs kar sbas/ phyis dus stag lha'i thugs sras dbra khyung g.yung drung bstan 'dzin dbang rgyal gsang mtshan stag chung dbal 'bar stag slag can bdag la babs pa/ me lug zla 6 tshes la khyung nag pho brang du gtan la phab pa'o/ bkra shis//
